name: fibSum_eq
prelude:
def fib : Nat → Nat
  | 0 => 0
  | 1 => 1
  | n + 2 => fib n + fib (n + 1)

def fibSum : Nat → Nat
  | 0 => 0
  | n + 1 => fibSum n + fib n
statement: theorem fibSum_eq (n : Nat) : fibSum n + 1 = fib (n + 1)
proofs:
induction n with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n ih =>
    simp only [fibSum, fib]
    omega
  induction n with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [fibSum, Nat.add_right_comm, ih, fib, Nat.add_comm]
